tables.name: Keep Size
tables.description: The flat area the keep occupies (each floor roughly the same). Its Base Size Modifier (BSM) sets the number of rooms. 1 square = 5 ft.

results.name: Small
results.description: BSM 1. Floor space 5x5 squares, or 7 squares across if round.

results.name: Medium
results.description: BSM 2. Floor space 7x7 squares, or 9 squares across if round.

results.name: Large
results.description: BSM 3. Floor space 9x9 squares, or 11 squares across if round.

results.name: Very Large
results.description: BSM 4. Floor space 11x11 squares, or 13 squares across if round.
